reason: The named lab and a batch report that matches the box number is what I look for, and 200 mg bisglycinate with no oxide is a real dose. At the $24.99 launch price I would try one box, and the empty-box guarantee lowers the risk.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. I also need to open the lab report and check it is real before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report for my batch did not open, or the lab was not a real named lab, I would not buy. A price at or below $24.99 after the launch period would make me reorder.
